cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum asks about the holiday argument, lead with my offer to drive. Give her the solution before the complications.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, that's the cause. Put it after the recovery plan, please; otherwise you're giving her a problem with no answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All of it, certainly. Tell her I offered to drive us, then explain the lost tickets. In that order, please.

reason: Remove unnecessarily indirect quoted pronoun and fairness slogan while explicitly accepting B whole-story condition and retaining A preferred frame.
